raw_response:
I've been farming these 5 mu for 35 years, all cotton. My wife and I handle most of the work ourselves — the children work in the city now. With only two of us, cotton is manageable, and I know this crop well. I don't try new tricks; I do what has kept us going.

I'm planting in mid-April, around the 20th, once the soil warms up properly. Last year I planted on April 18th and it worked out fine. I'm buying improved seed from the supply store — about 30 yuan per mu. I tried saving seed once years ago and the yield dropped, so I always buy certified seed now.

For fertilizer, I'll put down 50 kg per mu of compound fertilizer — the 15-15-15 type — before planting as base. Then at flowering in early July, I'll topdress with about 12 kg per mu of urea. The extension people say I could use more, but this has given me steady yields around 250 kg per mu, and fertilizer prices went up again this year. I don't calculate nitrogen precisely — I go by bags. Around 13 kg of nitrogen per mu total, I suppose.

I'll irrigate twice from the well: once when the plants flower in early July, and once in mid-August when the bolls are filling. The water is metered now, so I have to be careful, but two times is the minimum or the bolls won't develop properly. I use furrow irrigation.

For pests, I'll spray herbicide once right after planting, and insecticide two or three times for bollworm through July and August. Cotton always needs insecticide — you can't skip it. I watch my neighbor's fields too; when he sprays, I know it's time.

I hire Old Wang's tractor for rotary tillage before planting — 50 yuan per mu. For picking, my wife and I do most of it, but we hire local women for about a week to help. Picking 5 mu by hand is too much for just us, especially with my back these days. Hired picking costs about 100 yuan per day.

I expect about 250 kg per mu this year if the weather holds — about the same as last year. It's not exciting, but it's steady. Cotton prices are around 7.5 yuan per kg for seed cotton, so after costs I should clear enough for the two of us.
